SYNTHETIC DEMO · Every value on this page is invented to exercise the layout. No game or model was run.

Language models commanding armies in real time

Each model reads a text report of a Total War: WARHAMMER III battle and orders its regiments through a game mod while the battle keeps running. These scenarios are provisional: calibrating distinct decision problems comes before a broader comparison of the strongest models.
